messages:
Sam (CS): heads up — Acme integration is spiking function-call errors after last night's rollout. Customers seeing 400s with "invalid args" from tool invocation. thread_ts=1943126789
Maria (Support-Ops): which customer and api key? any error sample?
Sam (CS): customer id 9042. repro in prod logs. Error snippet: `400 Bad Request {"error":"tool call invalid args"}`. Seen ~5% of calls failing, jumped to 22% after a retry storm.
Maria (Support-Ops): ouch. any visible change in model or prompt?
Sam (CS): they pinned model to `open-redwood-v1.3` yesterday. But their system prompt contains a few-shot example block with old arg names. I pasted the portion below:
```
System: You are the payment tool. Examples:
1) {
  "action": "charge",
  "amount_cents": 2500,
  "currency": "USD"
}
```
The function schema expects `amount` as integer (dollars) and `currencyCode`. The model is emitting the example-style keys (amount_cents) which runtime rejects.
Eva (Eng-ML): thanks. sounds like sticky few-shot examples are overriding the function docs -> output schema drift. Is temperature high or do they use few_shot in user messages?
Sam (CS): they have temperature 0.2 and a system-level examples block. No user few-shot.
Chris (Eng-Runtime): runtime is strict about function arg keys — we do JSON schema validation. If model emits old keys we reject. We can add a temporary tolerant-coerce mode to map common legacy keys -> current keys for that customer. Quick mitigation: pin model to `open-redwood-v1.2` or strip system examples on the client side.
Maria (Support-Ops): billing charts show retry loops. billing spike +4x in last hour. logs: `POST /v1/call 500` retries x3 from client -> token usage doubled. Customer is furious :grimace:.
Sam (CS): minimal repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
 -d '{\n  "model":"open-redwood-v1.3",\n  "temperature":0.2,\n  "messages":[{"role":"system","content": "<system with examples>"},{"role":"user","content": "Charge $25 for order 123"}],\n  "functions":[{"name":"payment_tool","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"integer"},"currencyCode":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount"]}}]}'
```
Response sample (model output):
```
{
  "name":"payment_tool",
  "arguments":{
    "action":"charge",
    "amount_cents":"2500",
    "currency":"USD"
  }
}
```
This is what fails schema validation.
Eva (Eng-ML): yep — model learned old example schema. Fix plan: 1) remove few-shot examples from system or rewrite them with the canonical JSON; 2) enforce function metadata in the model prompt via explicit JSON schema injection so generation matches expected keys; 3) add a training constraint in our onboarding docs. I can prepare a quick PR to transform examples automatically. :+1: :eyes: 
Chris (Eng-Runtime): for immediate relief I can deploy a small compatibility layer that coerces numeric strings to ints and renames `amount_cents` -> compute `amount = amount_cents / 100` for known legacy patterns. Will push a canary patch to prod for that customer. Also adding a metric to flag function arg mismatches to reduce time to detect.
IncidentBot: deploy "compat-legacy-args" canary started by chris at 1943126835 — status: in-progress
Maria (Support-Ops): nice. can we also throttle client retries? they are hammering us. suggest adding a short backoff and 429 for repeated quick retries.
Sam (CS): I'll message the customer's engineering lead with a suggested short-term config: set retries to 2 and backoff 500-2000ms, pin to v1.2 or remove examples. Also collecting additional model output samples and raw request ids.
Eva (Eng-ML): I'll open PR to sanitize system examples and include explicit function parameter documentation injection into the prompt. Also adding a test case in model onboarding that ensures generated args pass the function schema.
Chris (Eng-Runtime): starting canary now. will follow up with rollback timestamp if anything odd.
Maria (Support-Ops): prioritizing a billing credit for the spike. filing CS ticket now.
Sam (CS): thanks team. putting a short repro doc in the ticket and attaching this thread. will update when canary completes. :rocket:
